verdict.rationale: cubic can be driven in natural language across several surfaces. Users can comment in PRs to trigger reviews, ask questions and request fixes ("@cubic-dev-ai review this PR", replies asking for clarification). They can also ask the chat sidebar to "tour this PR" or explain selected code. Through the official MCP server, a coding agent can request reviews, triage issues, and manage the subscription, seats and roles on the user's behalf. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on confirmation that natural-language commands work reliably, and no evidence that configuration (cubic.yaml, custom agents) or analytics can be operated via natural language rather than files and dashboards.
